elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 only continues Software support and maintenance, conditioned on Corio's annual payments. It does not require migration, handover, or other transition assistance. The margin comment is non-operative.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: No six-month transition-assistance period is stated. The survival of support and maintenance does not establish a transition-assistance period.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 refers to annual support and maintenance payments specified in the Agreement, not transition assistance charged at then-current rates.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 requires Commerce One, upon termination or expiration for any reason, to export and return to Corio all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Corio or its Customers that is in Commerce One's possession or control.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 expressly requires export and return within thirty days.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 does not specify any format. The word “export” alone does not require a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 permits return or destruction of Confidential Information as alternatives, and Section 11.4 does not require deletion after return.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification obligation appears in the rendered clause.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must provide transition assistance.
elements.evidence: The surviving Software support and maintenance obligation does not expressly cover transition, migration, handover, or related cooperation. The margin comment cannot supply the missing operative obligation.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days after expiry or termination.
Upon expiry or termination, Vendor must export Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 requires Commerce One to export and return all data of Corio or its Customers upon termination or expiration for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline for the export and return.

result.reason: The redline adds a clear 30-day data export and return obligation, satisfying the data component of the fallback. It does not add operative transition-assistance language or a 90-day period, so the fallback is incomplete. The existing survival of paid Software support and maintenance is not equivalent to transition assistance. The preferred position also lacks a six-month assistance period, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, post-return deletion, and deletion certification. The added provision is generally compatible with the existing terms, but the redline is not minimal as defined because it does not reach any complete position.
